einzeiler: Pastor Michael Todd on his sabbatical, marriage, and the power of crazy faith.
kurzfassung: Pastor Michael Todd joins Hoda Kotb to discuss his journey from sound technician to leading Tulsa's Transformation Church. He shares how taking a month-long sabbatical and creating daily margin transformed his life and leadership. The conversation also explores intentional marriage habits, overcoming past insecurity, and his latest book, Crazy Faith.
stichpunkte: Transformation Church leader Pastor Michael Todd reflects on taking a month-long social media break.
He views daily solitude and quiet time as essential margin for receiving fresh inspiration.
Constant rushing and overworking often mask unresolved childhood insecurity and pain.
Writing down a weekly relationship vision transformed his marriage and dating habits.
He started his ministry path in the sound booth before stepping into the lead pastor role.
The church gifted $200,000 homes to the last three surviving victims of the 1921 Tulsa race riots.
He advocates operating on 51% faith rather than waiting for absolute certainty.
A physical transformation helped him break the cycle of drifting into unhealthy habits.
A memorable sermon illustration involved trusting a small chair designed specifically for you.

clips.text: Historical accounts show that Jesus frequently withdrew from his demanding public ministry to spend time in solitude.
Scheduling mandatory weekly dates with his wife ensures that family priorities never get sidelined by other commitments.
The church raised funds to surprise the final three centenarian survivors of the Tulsa race massacre with mortgage-free homes.
After stepping on the scale at 264 pounds, he committed to a healthier lifestyle and dropped 35 pounds in four months.
A sermon illustration featuring a small, unconventional chair challenged a volunteer to trust divine design over appearances.

beschreibung:
Pastor Michael Todd is the leader of the Transformation Church in Tulsa, Oklahoma. This dynamic 34 year-old speaks to the power we all have to transform our own lives, turning the impossible into the reachable. He joins Hoda for an honest, high-energy and invigorating conversation, touching on topics from renewing relationships to overcoming struggles from the past. As Pastor Todd has seen in his life—and hopefully you will see in yours after listening—an idea, goal or a vision is only crazy until it happens.
